q: 2018 年 8 月的 GMV 是多少？
gold: SELECT sum(gmv) FROM v_order_fact WHERE order_date >= '2018-08-01' AND order_date < '2018-09-01' AND order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

q: 订单量最多的 5 个州是哪些？
gold: SELECT c.customer_state, count(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING (customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 ASC LIMIT 5

q: 复购率是多少？（同一用户下过 2 单及以上）
gold: WITH u AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, count(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING (customer_id) WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1) SELECT sum(CASE WHEN n >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / count(*) FROM u

q: 平均评分最高的 5 个商品类别是哪些？（至少 50 条评价）
gold: WITH rev_cat AS (SELECT DISTINCT rv.review_id,   ct.product_category_name_english AS category,   rv.review_score FROM order_reviews rv JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = rv.order_id  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name  WHERE ct.product_category_name_english IS NOT NULL)SELECT category, avg(review_score) AS avg_score, count(*) AS n FROM rev_cat GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 50 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 ASC LIMIT 5

q: 平均配送时长是多少天？
gold: SELECT avg(date_diff('day', order_purchase_timestamp, order_delivered_customer_date)) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
